digest: Mapped stop, cancellation, terminal-summary, and test areas; implementation shows several spec-sensitive behaviors and no visible unit-test files.

implementationMap.evidence: Lines 5-27 map signals by workflowRunPath(cwd, runId); lines 17-21 unregister and delete empty sets.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Foreground AbortSignals are tracked per run and returned cleanup removes registrations.

implementationMap.evidence: Lines 61-86 create a controller, invoke check immediately, poll with setInterval, catch read failures, and dispose via clearInterval.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Default pollMs is 200 and minimum is 1; checks foreground signals and readWorkflowStopIntent; dispose only clears the interval.

implementationMap.evidence: Lines 43-59 construct name WorkflowStopRequested and message workflow stop requested for <runId>; predicate also accepts a message prefix.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Abort reason uses the required name/message, while the classifier considers either name or message prefix.

implementationMap.evidence: Lines 89-99 call readWorkflowStopIntent without catch and throw the requested error when intent or foreground abort is present.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Synchronous foreground checks surround the disk read, and read failures propagate from this path.

implementationMap.evidence: Lines 13-32 inspect AbortError, cancelled flags, error/reason values, and recursively parse content[].text JSON with parsed !== value.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Recognizes the three named strings plus cancelled/timeout and boolean cancellation markers; JSON content is recursively inspected with a self-reference guard.

implementationMap.evidence: Lines 64-69 map completed plus degradation to completed_degraded; lines 80-95 handle direct-dynamic control absence via the final fallback.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Non-dynamic degradation and missing/unrecognized dynamic control produce dedicated semantic statuses.

implementationMap.evidence: Lines 27-34 expose outputRetryAttempts and launchRetries; lines 103-109 sum attempts across all tasks.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Output retries are summed under the specified outputRetryAttempts field, but launch retries are exposed as launchRetries.

implementationMap.file: No test files found under the repository
implementationMap.evidence: Repository file listing contains SPEC.md, tsconfig/package.json, and three src/*.ts files only.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: No visible unit-test implementation provides evidence for S1-S7, C1-C2, or T1-T3.

unmappedAreas: Q1 unit tests for each S, C, and T requirement
External implementations of ./store.js and ./types.js are absent from this excerpt
Runtime tests for in-flight dispose behavior are absent
notes: This stage maps evidence only; it does not make final conformance judgments.
Most relevant review points are poll defaults/floor, error predicates, cancellation allowlist, public retry field naming, and missing tests.
